title: fix(polli-cli): configure Pi provider API key
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds Pi's required custom-provider API key marker
- Keeps the real credential in `auth.json`
- Reports older incomplete Pi configs as unconfigured so rerunning setup repairs them
- Tests: `npm run test` (57 passed), `npm run build`

gist.headline: Pi Gets Its Pollen
gist.blurb: Polli CLI now leaves Pi with the little provider marker it needs to recognize its API key. Existing credentials stay safely tucked in auth.json, where bees keep their important receipts.
gist.summary: Fixed Polli CLI's Pi harness setup by adding Pi's required custom-provider API key marker, retaining the real credential in auth.json, and flagging older incomplete configurations so setup can repair them.
gist.impact: Developers configuring Pi through Polli CLI will now get a recognized provider configuration, while rerunning setup automatically repairs older incomplete Pi setups.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful CLI mechanic fitting a small key-shaped provider marker into a cozy Pi configuration terminal, while a separate locked auth.json jar keeps the real credential safe. Tiny code-plants and flowers make the repaired setup feel like a garden tending task rather than an ominous authentication ritual.
